dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Lamaohy is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Lamaohy has been observed to be easily startled by environmental stimuli. He is also observed to be highly kennel reactive. Noted to push off the wall, pull hard towards the neighboring dogs, rear of his hind legs, and bare teeth. With familiar handlers, Lamaohy is social and receptive to treats. Medically Lamaohy is apparently healthy.

Lamaohy came into ACC as a stray. Because of this we do not know how he would be in a home environment. During his time in the care center, Lamaohy has been observed to be doing kennel stress-related behaviors such as licking the kennel bars and heavy-panting in the kennel. Lamaohy has been noted to hard bark and paw at the kennel door when handlers approach. Recently Lamaohy has also been observed to push off walls when passing kennels, baring teeth. His is noted to be a social dog who is responsive with handlers. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
